_comment: Luraph v14.7 opcode map for sample_sigil.lua. Opcode numbering is PER-BUILD (Luraph randomises it), so this is specific to this sample. Operand fields a/b/c/d are as emitted by run_vm.py --mode disasm (parallel arrays j/c/q/U indexed by pc). Semantics were recovered by register-delta analysis (semantics.py): snapshot the register file each step and diff. 'confirmed' = strong/direct evidence; 'inferred' = consistent with the observed pattern but not uniquely pinned (e.g. no-register-write ops are SETTABLE-or-jump).

286.name: JMP
286.effect: C = target; unconditional jump. Dominant opcode -> control flow is flattened at the bytecode level (every block ends in a JMP).
286.evidence: no register write; jump target in operand

168.name: GETGLOBAL/CALL
168.effect: e[a] = _G[name] or call result (d is a global name string, e.g. "Vector3")

49.name: SETTABLE
49.evidence: e[a] is a table in 1149/1149 observed executions

50.name: CALL
50.effect: call e[a](...) with return discarded (void call)
50.evidence: e[a] is a function in the large majority of executions; no register write

206.name: GETINDEX?
206.effect: reads a field into e[c] (function/value); mostly no visible reg change

228.name: CALL?
228.effect: call/close; clears a register range (consumed args/results)
